data.summary: The pod startup was delayed by an app_init phase that lasted 15.5 seconds, exceeding the 10.0-second SLO. The primary bottleneck was the init.compute span, which consumed 12.7 seconds of this time while constrained by a low CPU limit of 250m.

findings.statement: The pod took 21.0 seconds to reach the Ready state, breaching the 10.0-second SLO.
The app_init phase accounted for 15.5 seconds of the total startup time.
The init.compute span was the slowest component of the initialization, taking 12.7 seconds to complete 100 units of work.
The container is restricted by a low CPU limit of 250m, which is likely insufficient for the compute-intensive initialization tasks.

ruled_out.reason: The image pull duration of 4.074 seconds for 53MB is within normal operational parameters.
The image pull throughput was 13.09 MB/s, which indicates normal network and registry performance.
The scheduling phase took 0.0 seconds, indicating no delay in pod placement or resource availability on the node.
The readiness probe completed immediately after the app_init phase finished, showing no delay in the readiness check itself.

recommendations.rationale: The application performs compute-intensive work during initialization, and the current 250m CPU limit is likely constraining this process.
